title: My IPTV Auto Playlist
sources: Sportlink Update / Jio TV Auto Update (sportlive18)
source_failures: All-Playlist (sportlive18): 404 Client Error: Not Found for url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sportlive18/All-Playlist/main/combined.m3u

repository_integrations.reason: Repository contains api, fancode, live, prime, willow and world-sports modules plus fetch_and_generate.py. No verified root-level M3U output URL was found during this integration, so it is documented but not guessed as a feed.

Repository contains FanCode web pages (FC.html, fancode.html, fancode2.html, fc-ios.html, fc-play.html, index.html, play.html), not a confirmed standalone M3U output. Its player UI is not imported into the playlist.
GitHub currently redirects this repository URL to sportlink-update; integrated once using sportlink-update/Combined.m3u.
